remarks: A Stylish Retreat on Bell Island.     Wake up on the water with a cup of coffee, and end your day with sunset views. This two bedroom, two full bathroom (plus two half bath) waterfront cottage, nestled in a peaceful seaside location.   Enjoy a spacious courtyard behind the large garage, with plenty of room for outdoor entertaining. Launch your kayak or paddleboard directly from the property into Farm Creek.   This home is located within Bell Island, where you can relish in the sunlight during summer months as you enjoy Bell Island's two private beaches and four private parks. Boat mooring available through the harbormaster. Come make some memories.
